text:
mara: quick note - Seneca-14b (int4) canary started. Seeing warm-start OOMs on single-stream long gens (>1200). frag metric stays high after first heavy request.
ops-bot: Canary deployed: seneca-14b-int4 @ pool-omega (10 replicas).
ishaan: repro? GPU types and microbatch?
mara: single-client stream ~1300 tokens, reproduces on A100/H100. microbatch=1 fastest.
mai: hypothesis = KV slot churn + free-list fragmentation. different idea: try lowering default max_new_tokens to 384 and add a small per-replica soft_reserve (150MiB) to smooth spikes.
ishaan: also propose compact-on-hot-evict and startup primer (60 tokens) to allocate stable KV shapes. add tinypage-align allocator patch if we still see big free_chunk counts.
mai: microbatch policy: microbatch=1, batching_window=25ms, max_concurrent=2. token-bucket throttle on single-streams to cap pathological long gens.
mara: running A/B: control (max_new=1024, no reserve) vs variant (max_new=384, soft_reserve=150MiB, compact_on_evict=true, startup_prime=60, batching_window=25ms). collecting alloc_hist:5m, free_chunk_count:5m, OOM traces.
ishaan: add conv-bench 1k for quality check (BLEU/Rouge/LLMScore). rollback if quality delta > 3% or OOM rate > 0.4%.
mai: if tail OOMs persist after this, next steps: tinypage-align allocator, per-slot slab pools, or kernel-affinity for allocator thread.
mara: ok starting canary now. will post results + plots at 6483228000. :rocket:
